motions.description: Approve the minutes of the March 12, 2024 regular meeting

Approve the payment of payroll checks for department numbers 01 through 04, and accounts payable check numbers 23730 through 23762, in the total amount of $110,018.18, which includes payroll through March 29, 2024
Approve the financial statements for March 12, 2024, subject to audit
Approve the annual resolution authorizing the issuing of library cards to nonresidents
Increase sick leave accrual from 6 days per year to 12 days per year for full time employees

Convene in Executive Session to discuss the minutes of meetings lawfully closed under the Open Meetings Act, whether for purposes of approval by the body or semi-annual review as mandated by Section 2.06 (5 ILCS 120/2(c)(21))
Approve the executive session minutes of October 10, 2023 and November 14, 2023
Release to the public the executive session minutes of October 10, 2023 and November 14, 2023, while all other executive session minutes remain confidential
